description: This file defines functions and types for constructing and sending webhook payloads, including template application, signature creation, and HTTP POST requests. It handles various payload types related to calendar events, user statuses, and webhooks, with specific logic for Zapier integration.

methods.name: addUTCOffset
methods.description: Adds UTC offset information to event payload data based on time zones.

methods.name: getZapierPayload
methods.description: Constructs a JSON string payload formatted for Zapier from event data.

methods.name: applyTemplate
methods.description: Applies a Handlebars template to data, returning either a string or JSON string based on content type.

methods.name: jsonParse
methods.description: Safely parses a JSON string, returns false if parsing fails.

methods.name: isOOOEntryPayload
methods.description: Type guard to check if data is an OOOEntryPayloadType.

methods.name: isNoShowPayload
methods.description: Type guard to check if data is a BookingNoShowUpdatedPayload.

methods.name: isDelegationCredentialErrorPayload
methods.description: Type guard to check if data is a DelegationCredentialErrorPayloadType.

methods.name: isEventPayload
methods.description: Type guard to check if data is an EventPayloadType.

methods.name: sanitizeAssignmentReasonForWebhook
methods.description: Sanitizes the assignmentReason field in event payloads to conform to expected schema.

methods.name: sendPayload
methods.description: Constructs and sends a webhook payload HTTP POST request, handling templates, signatures, and content types.

methods.name: sendGenericWebhookPayload
methods.description: Constructs and sends a generic webhook payload with optional root data.

methods.name: createWebhookSignature
methods.description: Creates a HMAC SHA256 signature for webhook payload verification.

methods.name: _sendPayload
methods.description: Internal function to perform the HTTP POST request for webhook payloads.
